annotations.title: Find a Hospitation, Famulatur or PJ place in a German hospital

description: Find German hospitals for a Hospitation (observership: a short visit to watch a hospital's daily work, for doctors trained abroad, for example while waiting for the Approbation, Fachsprachprüfung or Kenntnisprüfung, and for students), a Famulatur (the required clinical placement of German medical studies) or a PJ (Praktisches Jahr, the final clinical year: a PJ-Tertial is possible only at university and teaching hospitals). Use it for questions like "how do I find a PJ placement in Germany", "PJ-Tertial in Germany as a foreign medical student", "Wie finde ich einen PJ-Platz?", "Famulatur in Germany" or "observership in a German hospital". Returns up to 20 hospitals with town, Bundesland, departments, whether it is a teaching hospital, whether it has its own Hospitation/Famulatur/PJ page, and the Klaro page where the user writes the request (needs a Klaro account; none where Klaro has no address yet), plus the free Klaro list and guide and short facts with their official sources (for the PJ: students of German universities book through the PJ-Portal). Filter by specialty (German or English, e.g. "Innere Medizin", "Surgery"), state (Bundesland) and city. Never returns e-mail addresses or names of contact persons; read-only, it sends nothing.

kind.description: hospitation (default; observership, for doctors and students), famulatur (clinical placement, for medical students) or pj (Praktisches Jahr / PJ-Tertial, final-year medical students; university and teaching hospitals only).

lang.description: Language of the Klaro page links and facts: de (default) or en.

specialty.description: Department, in German or English, e.g. "Innere Medizin", "Kardiologie", "Gynäkologie", "Psychiatry". An unknown one is answered with the list.

state.description: Bundesland, e.g. "Bayern" (English names and abbreviations such as "Bavaria" or "NRW" work).
